mainEntity.name: How do I determine the right size and layout for a guest cottage?

acceptedAnswer.text: A guest cottage can be planned as a compact studio or as a multi-room home, generally ranging from 400 to 1,000 square feet depending on local zoning caps. To establish the right footprint, consider who will occupy the space and their daily mobility needs. A simple guest bedroom with an en-suite bath requires minimal square footage. If the cottage is meant for aging parents or extended multigenerational living, the plan should incorporate wider doorways, a zero-threshold walk-in shower, dedicated living space, and practical storage. Local accessory dwelling codes often establish maximum square footage limits tied to the size of the primary residence.
